name: iphone
blurb: iPhone frame mockup displays content via image or autoplay video.
description: An SVG-rendered iPhone hardware frame with cutout screen area. Displays either a static image or autoplay video with accurate screen positioning, rounded corners, and bezel framing.
use_when: Product landing pages, app demos, or marketing showcases displaying mobile app or web experiences.
avoid_when: When responsive sizing per viewport is critical; fixed aspect ratio requires explicit parent width.
a11y: SVG frame is decorative; video autoplays without user interaction control; alt text should be on content, not the frame.
